INSERT INTO broadcast.broadcast_requests
                (execution_id, revision, chain_id, from_address, state)
            SELECT
                $1,
                COALESCE(
                    (SELECT MAX(revision)
                    FROM broadcast.broadcast_requests
                    WHERE execution_id = $1),
                    0
                ) + 1,
                $2,
                $3,
                'received'
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM broadcast.broadcast_requests
                WHERE execution_id = $1
                AND (
                        state = 'submitted'
                    OR (
                        state = 'received'
                        AND updated_at > now() - interval '2 minutes'
                    )
                )
            )
            RETURNING revision
